newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil seen up $1, Brent flat to 5 cts lower.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil seen up $1, Brent flat to 5 cts lower.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures are expected to open about $1-$1.25 a tonne higher on Wednesday helped by mildly supportive U.S. inventory data and a firm Brent crude finish on Tuesday, brokers said.
June Brent, which closed 35 cents higher at $18.61, should open unchanged to about five cents weaker in line with early talk in Singapore, they added.
"The stocks figures are mildly supportive for gas oil and the technical picture looks encouraging too," said a broker.
The American Petroleum Institute (API) said middle distillate stocks fell by 1.4 million barrels last week.
